routes.name: ALL to Elasticsearch
routes.description: ES-First: ALL events (pre-classified at input via universal_classifier) go to Elasticsearch. Non-final: events continue to SIEM/S3 routing.

routes.name: SIEM to Splunk
routes.description: SIEM events: sets index=cribl_siem and sourcetype=cribl:siem, then sends to Splunk HEC.

routes.name: Ops to S3 Archive
routes.description: Operational events go to MinIO S3 for long-term archival.

routes.name: Default Catch-All
routes.description: Safety net: any unclassified/fallback events. Final catch-all.
